India's First Bullet Train: Speed, Capacity, and Design Details Emerge

Details have emerged regarding India's first bullet train, which is designed to reach a maximum test speed of 280 kmph. The train will consist of 8 coaches and have a passenger capacity of 557. The reported speed is 249 kmph.
